categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Anoky Group Co., Ltd primarily operates in the fine chemicals sector focusing on the research, production, and sales of differentiated high-end dyes including disperse dyes, reactive dyes, acid dyes, wool reactive dyes, nylon dyes, and digital printing inks. Additionally, the company has expanded into the digital AI and computing power sector, offering GPU cloud acceleration services and AI-driven digital printing solutions. It also engages in environmental protection materials and military-related special materials through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced continuous mechanization and automated control in dye intermediate and dye production, integrating green, intelligent, and automated processes. It has developed proprietary technologies in disperse dyes with high fixation rates and environmental benefits, low-temperature reactive dyes, and digital ink formulations. The computing power segment is based on a self-developed distributed GPU cloud platform with patented core technologies ensuring security and scalability. The company also collaborates with top universities for R&D in green manufacturing and AI applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include textile and garment manufacturers requiring high-performance dyes for polyester, cotton, wool, nylon, and blended fabrics, as well as digital printing clients in fashion, home textiles, cultural and creative industries, and pet economy sectors. The computing power services cater to research institutions, universities, internet companies, financial technology firms, government enterprises, and individual innovators. The company’s products serve both domestic and international textile markets, with a focus on mid-to-high-end niche segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai, Shandong (Yantai and Dongying), and subsidiaries in Jiangsu and Hainan. Sales and marketing networks cover major textile clusters in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Guangdong, Fujian, and northern China. The computing power and AI services are based in Shanghai with nationwide digital platform reach. The company also participates in international exhibitions and exports products globally, though overseas revenue is less than 10% of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Anoky operates mainly in the midstream and upstream segments of the dye and chemical supply chain. It produces dye intermediates and finished dyes, extending upstream into raw material synthesis to stabilize supply and reduce cost volatility. Downstream, it serves textile printing and dyeing enterprises. In the digital AI sector, it provides midstream cloud computing services and digital printing inks, bridging technology and end-user applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include advancing differentiated, environmentally friendly dye products, expanding production capacity with intelligent manufacturing upgrades, and deepening AI and computing power integration into textile digital printing. It emphasizes collaborative R&D with leading universities, patent development, and innovation in green manufacturing processes. Future plans focus on scaling dye intermediate projects, enhancing AI-driven design and manufacturing platforms, and developing multi-modal AI services to support personalized textile production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of dyes and chemical intermediates to textile manufacturers and digital printing inks to fashion and creative industries. The computing power segment generates income via elastic GPU cloud rental and subscription services targeting research and commercial clients. The company also earns from technology licensing, government subsidies, and investment income from subsidiaries and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Anoky positions itself as a leading domestic producer of mid-to-high-end differentiated dyes with strong R&D capabilities and a growing footprint in digital AI and computing power services. It competes with other Chinese dye manufacturers and emerging digital printing technology providers. The company leverages its integrated upstream production, innovation, and brand recognition to maintain competitive advantages in niche markets and new technology domains.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 973 million RMB, a 20.32% increase year-over-year, with net losses attributable to shareholders of about 4.75 million RMB. Total assets reached around 3.58 billion RMB, up 13.15% from the previous year. The company has been investing heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with a mixed profitability profile but a clear growth trajectory in revenue and asset base, supported by strategic acquisitions and project developments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Anoky emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly, and technologically advanced dye products tailored for specialized textile applications, offering superior color fastness, eco-compliance, and cost efficiency. Its digital AI and computing power platforms provide secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for personalized textile design and manufacturing, integrating AI creativity with flexible production. The company’s comprehensive technical support, strong brand portfolio, and continuous innovation create differentiated value for customers seeking advanced dyeing and digital printing solutions.
